title: sida carpinifolia var. acuta
intro: Sida carpinifolia var. acuta, commonly known as a type of mallow plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sida carpinifolia var. acuta include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
